query:
UPDATE moments SET artifact_id = ?
              WHERE artifact_id = ? AND done_at IS NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moments w
                                 WHERE w.artifact_id = ?
                                   AND w.kind = moments.kind
                                   AND w.at IS moments.at
                                   AND w.rule IS moments.rule
                                   AND w.done_at IS NULL)
